content.short: Flare Network is an EVM-based blockchain enabling apps to use data from other chains and the internet.
content.description: Flare Network is an EVM-based Layer 1 blockchain that enables developers to build applications using data from other blockchains and the internet. By providing decentralized access to high-integrity data, Flare unlocks new use cases and monetization options. Flare's State Connector protocols enable data from external blockchains and the internet to be used at scale with trustless security through native smart contracts. The Flare Time Series Oracle delivers highly decentralized price and data feeds to DApps on Flare without relying on centralized providers. Build on Flare to access broader data and serve multiple ecosystems.
